+## Summary
+
+Increase the pricing cache TTL from 900 seconds (15 minutes) to 3600 seconds (1 hour) to reduce cache refresh overhead and improve performance.
+
+## Changes
+
+- Updated `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` from 900 to 3600 in `pricing_cache.py`
+- Removed the unused `lookup()` function
+
+## Rationale
+
+The longer cache window reduces the frequency of cache refreshes, allowing pricing data to remain valid longer before invalidation. This decreases overhead from repeated cache updates and provides more stable pricing information to consumers.
+
+## Testing
+
+This change affects pricing cache behavior. Verify:
+- Pricing data remains current within the new 1-hour window
+- Cache refresh behavior works correctly with the extended TTL
+- No adverse effects on pricing accuracy or feed updates
